title: Robustness of Reinforcement Learning-Based Congestion Management in Low-Voltage Grids
abstract: arXiv:2607.16004v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Increases in photovoltaic generation, charging of electric vehicles and heat-pump demand challenge operating limits in low-voltage distribution grids. This requires curative curtailment methods that can operate under sparse observability, noisy measurements, and imperfect grid models. Unlike prior end-to-end reinforcement-learning approaches for partially observable curtailment, this work decouples congestion detection and control by combining a random-forest violation pre-classifier with an actor-critic controller, and evaluates its robustness to measurement noise and grid-parameter mismatch. The framework is tested on a real low-voltage grid using synthetic future operating scenarios with low observability and controllability. With accurate grid parameters, the controller reduces total violation magnitude by 98.9%, and this performance remains nearly unchanged under the tested measurement-noise settings. translated_title: 基于强化学习的低压电网阻塞管理鲁棒性研究
translated_abstract: 光伏发电的增加、电动汽车充电以及热泵需求对低压配电网的运行极限构成了挑战。这需要能够在稀疏可观测性、含噪测量和不完美电网模型条件下运行的矫正性削减方法。与以往针对部分可观测削减问题的端到端强化学习方法不同，本工作通过将随机森林违规预分类器与actor-critic控制器相结合，实现了阻塞检测与控制的解耦，并评估了该方法对测量噪声和电网参数失配的鲁棒性。该框架在一个真实的低压电网上进行测试，使用了具有低可观测性和低可控性的合成未来运行场景。在电网参数准确的情况下，控制器将总违规幅度降低了98.9%，并且在所测试的测量噪声设置下，该性能几乎保持不变。电网模型失配情形下的表现……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种将随机森林违规预分类器与actor-critic控制器相结合的解耦式强化学习阻塞管理方法，在真实低压电网中可将总违规幅度降低98.9%，并对测量噪声和电网参数失配表现出强鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decoupled reinforcement learning congestion management approach combining a random-forest violation pre-classifier with an actor-critic controller, which reduces total violation magnitude by 98.9% on a real low-voltage grid and remains robust to measurement noise and grid-parameter mismatch.
